native.name: exec
native.description: Run bash command at target node (bash -c $command). Default timeout 1800s, max 3600s; on timeout the command and its child processes are killed and the output so far is returned. For jobs that may run longer, start them in the background with output redirected to a file (e.g. `nohup cmd > job.log 2>&1 &`) and poll the log. Long output keeps its beginning and end.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to or within the configured workspace. Defaults to the workspace.

target.description: MUST select known node. Blank = current environment.

timeout_ms.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds (default 1800000, max 3600000). Set it explicitly for long builds, tests or media commands.
